name: lillian-dashboard
title: Lillian — Glass Dashboard
description: Free dashboard block with mint glass cards, orders, funnel, and acquisition sources. Responsive, viewport-fitting, and built with shadcn/ui Base UI components.

'use client' import { useMemo, useState } from 'react' import { ArrowDown, ArrowUp, ArrowUpDown, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Search, X } from 'lucide-react' import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button' import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card' import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input' import { createDemoOrders, filterOrders, orderCurrency, orderTotals, sortOrders, type OrderSort, type OrderStatus } from './orders-data' import './orders-page.css' const columns: { key: OrderSort; label: string }[] = [ { key: 'id', label: 'Order' }, { key: 'customer', label: 'Customer' }, { key: 'plan', label: 'Plan' }, { key: 'createdAt', label: 'Date' }, { key: 'status', label: 'Status' }, { key: 'value', label: 'Value' }, ] const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) export function OrdersPage({ query, onQueryChange }: { query: string; onQueryChange: (value: string) => void }) { const [orders] = useState(createDemoOrders) const [status, setStatus] = useState('All') const [sort, setSort] = useState<{ key: OrderSort; direction: 'asc' | 'desc' }>({ key: 'createdAt', direction: 'desc' }) const [pagination, setPagination] = useState({ page: 0, query: '', status: 'All' as OrderStatus, size: 8 }) const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(8) const filtered = useMemo(() => filterOrders(orders, query, status), [orders, query, status]) const sorted = useMemo(() => sortOrders(filtered, sort.key, sort.direction), [filtered, sort]) const totals = orderTotals(filtered) const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(sorted.length / pageSize)) const page = pagination.query === query && pagination.status === status && pagination.size === pageSize ? Math.min(pagination.page, pageCount - 1) : 0 const start = page * pageSize const visible = sorted.slice(start, start + pageSize) const metrics = [ { label: 'Order count', value: totals.count.toLocaleString(), caption: 'Total orders' }, { label: 'Orders value', value: orderCurrency(totals.value), caption: 'Before refunds' }, { label: 'Refunds', value: orderCurrency(totals.refunds), caption: `${filtered.filter(order => order.refund > 0).length} refunded orders` }, { label: 'Profit', value: orderCurrency(totals.profit), caption: 'After refunds & costs' }, ] function changeSort(key: OrderSort) { setSort(current => ({ key, direction: current.key === key && current.direction === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc' })) setPagination({ page: 0, query, status, size: pageSize }) } function changePage(next: number) { setPagination({ page: next, query, status, size: pageSize }) } return
